symptom: `log info node 'P' $Msg with ({1} = 'x');` logs the literal text `$Msg`; `send email (… Subject: $Subj with ({1} = '42') …)` sends the subject `$Subj` (describe prints them back as the literals '$Msg' / '$Subj'). `show message $Msg with ({1} = 'x')` and `validation feedback $o/A message $Msg with (…)` store '{1}' with ($Msg, 'x'): 'x' is a {2} nothing reads and the message shows its own unfilled {1}. check, exec and mx check (0 errors, 11.13.0) pass all four
cause: A message template is a text with {n} placeholders; an expression has none for `with (…)` to fill. `addLogMessageAction` and `emailTemplate` (mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go) fell back to `fb.exprToString(message)` as the template TEXT when the message was not a string literal but parameters were stated; `addShowMessageAction` / `addValidationFeedbackAction` made it '{1}' with the expression and appended the stated parameters after it. Nothing in check refused the shape
file: `mdl/executor/message_templates.go` (`messageTemplateRefusals` = the one decision, `checkMessageTemplates` = MDL-TEMPLATE01, `refuseMessageTemplates` for the builder), called from the four builders in `cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go`, `validate_microflow.go`, `validate_nanoflow.go`, `validate_alter_flow.go` and the rule branch of `validate_program.go`; tests `mdl/executor/message_templates_test.go`; fixture `mdl-examples/bug-tests/log-email-1683-expression-with-params.fail.mdl`
insight: Third instance of one class after `call rest service` (MDL-REST05, ako/mxcli#1444) and a Java action's text-template argument (MDL-JA02, ako/mxcli#1451): grep for `exprToString(` assigned to a template's TEXT, and for parameters appended after a '{1}' made from an expression. The #1444 finding claimed these four sites 'already applied' the literal-or-{1} rule — true only without `with (…)`; read the with-parameters branch, not just the plain one. The check has to run where each statement can appear: microflow walkBody covers only microflows, so the rule is a separate walk (walkFlowStatements, error-handler bodies included) wired into the nanoflow validator, the alter-fragment validator and the rule branch too; the builder refusal covers exec for all of them. Sibling found on the same branch and fixed: a multi-line string-literal email Body with parameters arrives as a SourceExpr around the literal and stored its SOURCE, quotes included, as the template — unwrap with restTemplateText, as #1444 did for the REST body
